description: This file implements common subexpression elimination (CSE) for Torch JIT graphs, including a class that performs the elimination and a function to invoke it.

classes.name: CommonSubexpressionEliminator
classes.description: A class that performs common subexpression elimination on a Torch JIT graph.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the CSE algorithm on a given graph or block, returning true if changes were made.

methods.name: getOrCreateAliasDb
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an alias analysis database for the graph.
